'''Hoverturrets''' were a type of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] utilized as [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] mounts<ref name="Reveal" /> as early as [[3627 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> The [[Devastator Hoverturret]] was a type of hoverturret.<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hoverturrets were first featured within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[October 20]], [[2020]], as part of an ongoing tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']].<ref name="Reveal" /><ref name="The Mandalorian">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''</ref>
